programmes.d: With $25 million up for grabs, daredevil pilot Grant Irvine (Antonio Sabato Jr.) enters the world's fastest jet race in this supersonic thrill ride.
The night he retires as a Nevada sheriff, Jerry Black (Nicholson) pledges to the mother of a murdered girl that he will find the killer.
A determined detective (Chuck Norris) sets out to rescue an aged diamond cutter from the hands of a murderous thief in this action-packed thriller.
Rollie Tyler, a movie special-effects man, accepts $30,000 from the Justice Department's Witness Relocation Program to stage the fake assassination of a mob figure who has agreed to name names.
